title: Dean’s Message

children: Welcome to the Society Hub at HKUST(GZ)

We live in an era shaped by rapid technological advancement, evolving economic landscapes, and increasingly complex societal challenges. At the same time, breakthroughs in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data-driven innovation are creating new possibilities for addressing these challenges and improving people’s lives.

Society Hub was established to respond to this changing world. Guided by our vision to be a global leader in addressing societal challenges in the age of intelligence, we are committed to preparing future leaders through interdisciplinary education, impactful research, and meaningful engagement with society. Our values—
Science for People, Technology for Good, and Synergy for Innovation

Building on the distinctive cross-disciplinary education system of The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), Society Hub brings together faculty members and students from diverse academic, professional, and cultural backgrounds. This diversity enables us to connect scientific inquiry and technological innovation with a deep understanding of society, policy, business, and human needs.
Our academic community advances education and research across four interconnected thrusts:
Carbon Neutrality and Climate Change, Financial Technology, Innovation, Policy and Entrepreneurship, and Urban Governance and Design

. Together, these thrusts address some of the most important questions facing society today—from sustainable development and climate action to digital transformation, responsible innovation, and the future of cities.

Through educational opportunities spanning undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral levels, we encourage students to think across disciplines, engage with real-world challenges, and translate knowledge into action. Here, learning extends beyond the classroom. Students work alongside scholars, industry leaders, policymakers, and communities to explore how ideas and technologies can generate lasting societal impact.

Our mission is not simply to help students navigate change, but to empower them to shape it. Society Hub is a place where innovation serves society, technology empowers humanity, and education inspires meaningful contributions to the world.
Welcome to Society Hub—a diverse and forward-looking community innovating for societal impact.
Let us make a difference, together.
